batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c KK Cooper b SK Trivedi

batting.name: AD Mathews
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b JP Faulkner

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c MR Marsh b AD Mathews

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c R Sharma b B Kumar

batting.name: BJ Hodge
batting.dismissal: c B Kumar b WD Parnell

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c UA Birla b WD Parnell

balls.text: Faulkner misses his length, drops this slightly short than full and Marsh gets across and gets under the ball, and lofts this over long-on for six
full and wide, driven wide of long-off, and Marsh retains strike for the last ball
back-of-the-hand slower ball from Faulkner. Mathews has no clue about it, and ends up slogging it to Rahane at long-on
full toss, on the pads, driven wide of long-on for two
full and wide again, can't get under it, gets just the single to long-off
full and wide, called
on a length, on the pads, clipped away
wide yorker, this is well bowled. Squeezes under his bat
short and wide, and he has missed out on it with the cut. Marsh is very displeased
Caught. By Finch. Who is sitting next to Donald. Full, on off, gets under it, and lofts it over long-off
yorker, middle and leg, dug out for a single to point
full and straight, driven straight to long-off for one
length ball, into the pads, and this has been deposited over square leg. Right in the slot for death overs. The crowd is not giving the ball back
full and wide, driven to the left of deep cover for two
full and wide, driven to long-off for one
short of a length, slower, pushed wide of point for one
well bowled. The wide yorker, just inside that white guide line for a wide. Mathews doesn't even try to play at it
full toss on off, driven to deep cover for one
short of a length, powered between long-on and deep midwicket for four. Cleared his front leg and swung
Mathews can go straight to a casino. He ends another over with an edged four. Slogs across one, gets a thick edge that goes between the keeper and short third man
full, on off, driven straight to long-off
looks to guide this fine on the leg side, but has found short fine leg
short of a length, on off, defended back to him
full, into the pads, nicely flicked away wide of deep midwicket for two
short of a length, middle and leg, driven off the back foot to extra cover
another slower ball, an offcutter, takes the thick outside edge for four past the keeper
slower ball, offcutter, moving away towards top of off. Defended off the back foot
short of a length, on off, defended back to him
on a length, middle and off, defended

Sanju Samson has done this superbly. Marsh drives, gets an inside edge onto the pad, which ricochets wide of Samson. Uthappa calls through for a single, but Samson is quick to get to it, has ripped the big glove off, and hits the middle of the middle stump
Marsh gets going finally. Drives hard at this full ball, between the bowler and mid-off
breaks the maiden through a swipe to midwicket and a misfield there
ugly hoick. As expected after four dots. Misses it by a mile
short of a length, on target. No room. Fourth dot of the over
on a length, on off, pushed to cover
full and straight, driven back at him
on a length, on off, defended to cover
he has mistimed the pull. Set him self up, but I think this is not as short as he is expecting it to. Mis-hits this to deep midwicket
worked into the leg side
slower ball, middle and leg, defended off the front foot
short of a length, outside off, punched to long-off
wide length ball, he moves across and drives it back over the bowler's head. That's Uthappa of the old. Fifty up
down the wicket and Uthappa gets a bit lucky. Gets a bottom edge past short fine leg
swatted like a fly. This is dismissive. A wide length ball, and he gets across to loft this over deep midwicket. His back leg is in the air as he plays the shot
short, angling in, Yuvraj tries to pull, gets a bottom edge into the rib area
defended to point with an open face
on the half-volley to Rahane. Short of a length again, stops a touch at him, and lobs towards point, but falls short of the diving Rahane
short of a length, gentle pace, wide, meat and drink for Yuvraj. He has beaten point with ease this time
short of a length, into the pads, clipped away for one
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover
clipped away off the pad,s wide of deep midwicket. It keeps racing away, and gets them three
short of a length, outside off, punched away square. Rahane saves four there with a dive
tries to pull this shortish delivery, but it is not short enough. The mis-hit, though, clears short midwicket and falls short of long-on
on a length, outside off, driven to mid-off
short of a length, wide, punched to cover
on a length, on off, defended off the front foot
timber. Rajasthan finally break through. Wide length ball, he wants to send it over midwicket, gets the expected inside edge onto the stumps
on a length, on off, defended off the front foot
driven to deep cover for one
wide down the leg side. There has been some shocking bowling on display today
whipped away to deep backward square leg
starts with length on the pads, flicked away wide of deep midwicket
short and wide, Uthappa wants to pull this from there, and gets an inside edge into his body
short of a length, outside off, punched to cover
short of a length, wide, pushed to third man for one
short and wide, called too
moves across to whip this shortish delivery into the leg side for four. Placed to the right of deep midwicket
hit straight to long-on for one
short, angling in, he makes room to punch this down the ground, and he has timed and placed it superbly. Straight of long-on for four
punched away to deep cover for one
Pune are playing like a side with nothing to lose. Tees off for a length ball outside off, and is beaten by the low bounce
cut hard into the ground, and it bounces over point's head for four. This has been powerfully hit, and sweetly timed, and isn't it even wide ball
short of a length, on off, worked to midwicket
Finch charges at this, makes room too, and ends up swinging inside its line
runs this down to third man for one
looks to flick it off the pads, but gets a leading edge that flies over point
good outswinger, on a length, outside off, Uthappa moves across to drive, but is beaten
short of a length, stays low to beat the cut
he has pulled this over long-on for sis. Short, a long hop really, wide outside off, and Uthappa gives it a good smack. Chandila takes the catch but has stepped over the rope with the ball
outswinger, beats the defensive push
dug in short, but doesn't rise that match. Uthappa stays away from it
and yet another has begun with a wide. This one, outside off
punched away nicely, but can't beat the man at cover
on a length, on the pads, pushed wide of Binny at deep midwicket for another couple
short of a length, just outside off, pushed to cover
short of a length, seaming in, picked away wide of long leg
punched to deep cover for one
short of a length, middle and leg, pushed to midwicket
on a length, angling in, driven on the up, and in the air. Clears mid-on with ease
wide half-volley, at a gentle pace, absolutely smashed... but straight to mid-off
short of a length, outside off, not wide enough to cut, passes under the bottom edge
on a length, outside off, pushed to cover for one
short of a length, on off, defended to leg
punched between cover and point, but Binny makes a diving save at the deepish cover-point
starts with a huge and short wide down the leg side. The diving Samson can't get to it
slower ball again, runs off the inside half of the bat for a single to deep midwicket
short of a length, just outside off, gets an inside edge onto the pad
short of a length, outside off, left alone
slower ball, but this is a wide half-volley, and Finch has enough time to recover and drive it over cover-point
fuller, outside off, driven to cover
short of a length, outside off, punched between mid-off and cover for two
another superb drive. He leans into a wide length ball, and just pushes at it, placing it between the diving cover and extra cover
short, wide, Uthappa wants to cut, gets a bottom edge through to slip
lovely shot. Wide length ball, Uthappa goes across, covers the swing, and drives this between mid-off and extra cover
bouncer, outside off, and Uthappa has pulled this over midwicket for four. That's sweetly timed, and nearly carries for a six
moves across to drive a full ball back to Watson
drives at a wide length ball, and is beaten on the inside edge as he goes outside its line
wide down the leg side. A big one too
full, on the pads, and the leg-side field is up, and it has been swept away for four
tossed up, middle and leg, driven to long-on
quicker delivery, skids on towards off, defended off the back foot
too short, outside off, Uthappa backs away to make room and cut him in front of square for four
too straight with the fine leg up, and he has been swept away for four
wide down the leg side, but he gets some bat on it, and takes a single to short fine
short of a length, middle and leg, looks to work this away. Is beaten
on a length, on off, drives at it, runs off the outside half of the bat to point
pushed into the leg side for one
the bad side of IPL fielding. Whipped away off the pads, and it goes straight through Chandila at long leg. Doesn't go low, doesn't get his body behind it
on a length, middle and off, stays back to push this into the covers for a single
wide down the leg side
short of a length, middle and leg, seams away to square him up and beat the edge
slightly short, Finch makes room, takes this from in front of off, and cuts it past cover-point for four
misfielded at cover, gets a single
short again, punched away for a single again
short of a length, on off, punched to deep midwicket again
flighted on off, bunted to leg for one
short, into the pads, punched to deep midwicket for one
gets a length ball, drives it hard between mid-on and midwicket. Binny is thrilled. Faulkner congratulates him

Birla has missed it. Faulkner has played this off the back foot, straight to midwicket, Binny wants the single. Never mind the single, he wants the strike. Faulkner is short, but Birla's throw has missed
full, outside off, dug out, Marsh makes a diving save at mid-off, but they take two because the ricochet has gone far
there is the IPL-style twist. Short, quick, hurrying on him, Samson pulls this straight down to midwicket. Another good fielding effort by Birla. Jaipur is stunned into silence
low full toss, nearly a yorker. Spooned out to third man for one
good yorker, middle and leg, somehow misses the leg stump. Rawat does well with the dive to deny them byes
well bowled. Yorker. Dug out. Binny is almost off his feet while keeping this out, but recovers fast enough to take the single
full and straight, Binny stands tall, clears the front leg, and smacks this over long-on. Marsh goes for the catch, but this clears him. Binny pumps his fist
Samson tries the low-percentage ramp, is beaten by the full ball, is hit on the shoulder, but is alert to Binny's call, and takes the single
full, on off, driven nicely through extra cover. Deep cover has to run around to keep this in. Birla does well with the dive to keep them down to one
oh what a full toss to bowl now. Driven hard to the right of point. Yuvraj goes flying to his wrong side, but has dropped it
good bouncer, on the helmet, pulled away in hope. Gets a single to midwicket
short of a length, wide, cut away to deep point
follows a quick wide delivery, gets a thick edge, and Parnell's pace takes it fine of third man
what a shot first ball. Driven on the up. What a back-foot cover-drive. He just rises with this shortish delivery, and drives this between mid-off and extra cover
short of a length, 140ks, on the stumps, runs it down to third man for one

Hodge wants the no-ball call. A full toss from Parnell, Hodge mis-hits it, he is saying this is too high. Caught at deep midwicket, by the way. The umpires are doing the sensible thing by checking the replays. They show the ball has dipped on him, and the bowler is fine
pitches this up finally, no turn on this, beats his inside edge as he looks to work this to leg
too many long hops. This time Binny has enough time to go back and deposit this over midwicket. This should have happened three balls earlier, really
gets away with another long hop. Pulled away to long-on again, and this time Marsh misfields to allow them the second. The eye was not on the ball forever
full, on the pads, slogged away, but there is a deep midwicket in place, who keeps them down to one
another long hop, stays a touch low, pulled to long-on for one
and he starts with a long hop. There is extra bounce, but it still a poor delivery, and has been cut away for four

Rahul Sharma takes a good catch. Rahane tries to manufacture one shot too many. This is a wide length ball, Rahane looks to loft this over square leg, and is playing too far away from his body. The top edge goes high, and swirls away from Sharma at the last moment, but he puts the dive in to send Rahane back
slight shimmy to push this to square leg for one. Superb running: this has been hit straight to the fielder on the ring
short of a length, on off, pushed wide of deep point for two
driven to long-off for one

edged, taken on a half-volley. This one shapes away from him, takes the edge as he pushes, but it is dying on Rawat behind the stumps. It has bounced in front of his gloves. Rawat says he doesn't know if it is clean, the replays show it bounced
length ball, outside off, Rahane swipes this over midwicket. That's dismissive, but a bit premeditated too
short of a length, outside off, left alone. What an over. Just one run and one wicket. Has brought Pune right back
Watson is gone now. Looks to cut a shortish delivery, there is no room, and he ends up playing on
and there could be the turnaround. Oh it isn't. I thought Watson had edged this shortish delivery through to the keeper, but it has come off the pad. Umpire Shamshudin has done well here
short of a length, middle and leg, worked into the leg side for one
short of a length, on off, defended to leg
a rare ugly swipe. Beaten by the length ball outside off

short, wide, this over is killing off the contest. Watson needs no second invitations for these, goes on a bended knee and cuts this past the diving fielder at point. Asking rate now is below where it started at the start of the innings
full, on off, driven to the left of long-on for one
wide full toss, driven with an open face, past point. Coolly done. This over could kill the chase off
short of a length, nicely played with soft hands towards long-on. They steal the second because this is played softly
wide length ball, Rahane pushes at it, gets a thick edge, between the keeper and short third man
Rahane brings up his fifty with a six too. Charges down at him, is surprised a touch by a low full toss, but goes ahead with an extra-cover drive, over the infield
slow, short, Watson has to abort any aggressive shot. Pushed to cover
full, into the pads, worked away for one
superb effort by Finch at extra cover. This is hit flat over his head, but Finch goes high with his left hands. Gets a touch on it, but that is all
shorter, quicker, Rahane rocks back fast and punches this wide of deep point for two
nearly a yorker outside off, dug out for a single
half-volley, on off, driven to long-off for one
slower ball, full, on the pads, worked away for another single
Dravid holes out finally. Gets too far under a length ball, but doesn't get much power behind it. Caught at long-off, but Dravid has set Royals on their way
slower ball, short of a length, bunted into the leg side for one
full, nearly a yorker, dug out for one
slower ball, driven to long-on for one
full toss, driven to deep cover for one
full and wide down the leg side. Not called a wide
down the wicket again, drives this to long-off for one
fifty comes up with a straight six. Leaves the crease, reaches the pitch of the ball, hasn't got all of it, and seems he can be caught, but he has hit this straight enough of long-on
short of a length, makes room to cut this to deep point for one
gives him the charge, not to the pitch of the ball, but drives this to long-on for one
down the wicket, gets a single to long-off
full, on off, driven to long-on
full and straight, dug out for one to long-on
full, on off, driven nicely, powerfully, past extra cover, and it beats sweeper-cover to his left too. That's 2000 IPL runs for him
full, outside off, driven to long-off for one
on a length, outside off, pushed to point with an open face
lofted to long-on for one
short of a length, on off, punched to cover-point
wide down the leg side again. Not called
short of a length, middle and leg, punched away to deep midwicket
full, on off, driven to long-on for one
full, outside leg, beats the sweep, but is called wide
length ball, middle and leg, worked away for one
shortish, looks to cut, edges it to short third
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on
short of a length, middle and leg, punched down to long-on for one
on a length, on off, he makes room to cut this to deep cover for one
flat, middle and leg, worked into the leg side for one
driven to long-on for one
flighted on off, chipped nicely over extra cover, and a misfield on the boundary, by Upadhyay, converts two into four
driven to long-on

full, on the pads, and Dravid has converted one into three. Pushed with soft hands, Marsh and Mathews are converging on this, Dravid initiates the second, and both fielders run past the ball trying to avoid a collision. And Dravid runs back for the third too
tossed up higher, defended off the front foot
full, on off, no turn, driven to long-off for one
full, on off, worked away into the leg side
short, wide, Rahane backs away to cut it away between point and short third man
short of a length, into the pads, Dravid whips this away after making room. Four more for Dravid
Dravid makes room, takes a shortish delivery, and launches this over the bower's head. Top-hand grip, but manages leverage
short of a length, on off, defended into the leg side for one
full, on off, pushed straight to mid-off
on a length, just outside off, defended
lovely shot. Gives him a bit of a charge, takes this length ball on a half-volley, and lofts this over mid-on for four
slapped right back at him. Driven on the up, back at him, and through him too, for a four to long-on
full, on off, runs off the inside half of the bat for one to leg
wide half-volley, runs off the outside half of the bat for one
dabs this down to third man for one
short of a length, middle and leg, gets an inside edge into the pad
wide length ball, left alone
cut away after making room, but Uthappa saves four with his dive at backward point
short of a length, into the pads, pushed for one into the leg side
full, on the pads, another freebie, picked away for four
that is a long hop, on off, and Rahane has launched this over deep midwicket
runs this down to third man for one
short of a length, outside off, punched to point where a misfield allows them the single
wide down the leg side
nice outswinger. This starts just outside off, Dravid looks to drive, but is beaten by the movement away
nicely driven inside-out. On a length, on off, he makes a bit of a room and drives on the up, between the stumps and mid-off
cramped on the shot again, another dot is in
backs away after making up his mind this has to go. The ball follows him, gives him no room, Dravid is looking to play this to off, but the mis-hit goes for four through mid-on
short of a length, seaming in, takes the inside edge onto the pad
short of a length, on off, defended with an open face
backs away to cut this to third man for one
slightly short, on off. Can't drive. Pushed back to him
fullish, on off, defended back to him
on a length, on the pads, misses on the drive, is hit on the pad
short of a length, on the stumps, worked away for a singe
swing first up. Starts middle and leg, hits the leading edge and goes back to KKU
punched away again, but finds backward point this time
bouncer, too high. Called a wide
slower ball, short of a length, outside off, defended to cover-point
lovely shot. Short of a length and wide again, and he has punched this between cover and cover-point
short of a length, wide, he looks to drive, gets a bottom edge onto the pad
short of a length, wide, punched away nicely through cover-point for four
Bhuvneshwar begins with an outswinger. Defended off the back foot
